'''2008 New York State Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 14 June 2008, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS15]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2008 New York State Championship.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
* '''Site:''' New York
* '''Dates:''' 14 June 2008
* '''Winner:''' —
